pkgmetadata.longdescription: NVAPI implementation for Wine on top of DXVK and vkd3d-proton, as used by Proton: lets games detect an NVIDIA GPU and use DLSS, Reflex and similar features. setup_dxvk_nvapi.sh (from this overlay) enables it in a prefix.

use.flag: Use sys-devel/crossdev for the toolchain rather than dev-util/mingw64-toolchain (requires manual setting up and is mostly unsupported, try disabling if have issues)
